g.text: HARSHA PILLI
JAVA · SPRING BOOT · REST APIs · CLOUD
Available for a 4- or 8-month developer co-op from January 2027 · Open to relocation anywhere in Canada
ABOUT
Before the degree, I spent three years at Computer Technology Corporation building REST APIs for an outbound
SMS, email and voice campaign platform, decomposing a monolithic staffing system into Spring Boot microservices,
and shipping one product to iOS and Android from a single Flutter codebase.
I owned the quality side of that work too: JUnit 5 and Mockito past 85% coverage, SonarQube and Fortify wired
into the SDLC, and 10+ Grafana dashboards that cut issue-detection time by roughly 30%.
I like backend systems where the correctness is checkable. Layered services, a real test suite, and a pipeline
that will not let a bad build through.
AT THE MOMENT
Working on
My Master of Applied Computer Science at Dalhousie, and DCode, an architecture research project
Collaborating on
Open-source Java and Spring Boot projects. I have an open PR against OpenMRS Core
Looking for
A 4- or 8-month developer co-op starting January 2027, anywhere in Canada
Learning
AWS Solutions Architect Associate, plus daily DSA ahead of Winter 2027 interviews
Ask me about
Spring Boot, REST API design, TDD with JUnit 5 and Mockito, monolith to microservices
Fun fact
I wrote 535 unit tests for a side project nobody asked me to build

Collabry · Brand and influencer collaboration platform

Built MFA stages two and three, the booking Lambda and the SQS to SNS reminder handler.

Pull Request #5937

Held the change to OpenMRS Java conventions through maintainer walkthrough review.

Built the editor behind it: editable layers, a dependency rule builder, and draft, publish and fork versioning.
